title: Orchestration and Pipeline Operations: Visual Guide
outline: Title: Orchestration and Pipeline Operations: Visual Guide

1. Retry Meets Idempotency | a task dying mid-partition, retried under append versus stage-then-commit | the orchestrator will re-run your task whether you like it or not, so a retry policy is only as safe as the write path beneath it

2. Edges Cost Time | a four-task DAG as a gantt, with and without an edge that encodes code order rather than data readiness | an unnecessary edge serializes work that could run in parallel and lengthens the critical path; a missing true edge publishes facts before dimensions

3. Green But Empty | four runs that all exited zero, and what the validation gate says about each | task status is not data quality — zero rows, a doubled join and a crashed check all look like success to the scheduler, so a blocking gate must fail closed

4. Threshold Goldilocks | four row-count rules judged against a sliding daily volume | exact equality is too tight and any-nonzero is too loose; relative change against a baseline plus an absolute floor is the shape that survives normal growth and still catches a cliff

5. Three Separate Decisions | the durable release pattern as six steps tagged code, data or visibility | shipping code, computing history and making data visible are three reversible decisions, and fusing them into one release is what makes a bad deploy irreversible
